articles.title: Boston is now offering ‘pet certificates’ for couples who wed at City Hall
articles.description:
The furriest members of the family can now get in on the big day.

The post Boston is now offering ‘pet certificates’ for couples who wed at City Hall appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Boston now offers 'pet certificates' for couples marrying at City Hall.
Couples can include their pets in the wedding celebration starting August 2023.
This initiative enhances the wedding experience for Boston residents and their furry companions.

articles.title: Kevin Nealon discusses Conan, Dunkin’, SNL and more ahead of local shows
articles.description:
In a hilarious interview, Nealon talks New England ties, hiking with Bill Burr, his Twitter and other funny things before stops in Boston and Portsmouth, New Hampshire.

The post Kevin Nealon discusses Conan, Dunkin’, SNL and more ahead of local shows appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Kevin Nealon will perform stand-up shows in Boston and Portsmouth, NH this August.
Nealon shares his New England ties and experiences hiking with comedian Bill Burr.
Local residents can expect humor related to Dunkin’ and SNL in Nealon's performances.

articles.title: Authorities release early ransom note in Nancy Guthrie case, hoping someone recognizes it
articles.description:
Saturday is the six-month mark since Guthrie went missing. No suspects have been arrested in her disappearance.

The post Authorities release early ransom note in Nancy Guthrie case, hoping someone recognizes it appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Authorities released a ransom note in Nancy Guthrie's case to gather public assistance.
Saturday marks six months since Nancy Guthrie went missing without any arrests.
Local residents are urged to review the note for potential leads in the investigation.
